style_prompt: Create ONE original children's picture-book illustration for a Traditional Chinese idiom learning website. Landscape 3:2, modern everyday setting, original people in present-day casual clothes. NO text, letters, numerals, titles, logos, watermarks or identifiable existing characters. Communicate the specific meaning through clear actions and relationships, suitable for elementary-school readers and mobile size. Hand-drawn delicate graphite pencil contours, soft translucent watercolor washes layered with colored-pencil grain and hatching on warm ivory textured paper. Restrained natural grass greens, pale sky blues, warm earthy browns, plenty of ivory breathing room. No flat digital color blocks, no glossy shading, no 3D, no imitation of any named artist. Scene:
scene_prompt: Modern graduation farewell symbolizing immense promising future. Talented young graduate wearing simple navy graduation robe holds a small working wind-turbine model and a blank rolled diploma, stepping out of school gate toward a broad sunlit path stretching into an expansive horizon. Proud teacher and family wave encouragement behind. In pale soft-edged aspirational panorama above road, graduate appears later as engineer building a vast clean-energy wind farm and another scene teaching new students, showing far-reaching future contributions. A large original soaring bird silhouette high in open sky is a symbolic echo, not a realistic giant creature interacting with people. Mood hopeful unlimited potential, not completed success or mere vacation. Natural body limbs, two hands assigned model and diploma, stable turbine base and windfarm structures. Landscape 3:2 graphite watercolor colored-pencil ivory paper, no readable text diploma letters numbers brands logos watermarks.
alt: 優秀畢業生帶著風車模型走向寬廣明亮的前路，老師家人在後方祝福，遠方想像小景呈現他未來建設風場與教導學生。
